🆕 NEW RELEASE: Attic Stories release new single Lover / Loser

Karlsruhe pop-punk band Attic Stories released Lover / Loser on 13 November 2026, their first standalone single in close to a year. The song opens the campaign for their debut album, for which no title or release date has been announced.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: blink-182 add Berlin Waldbühne show for 2027

blink-182 will play a headline show at Berlin's Waldbühne on 8 June 2027, with Billy Talent as support. It is a single date rather than a full German tour. The show follows the band's festival headline slots at Rock am Ring and Rock im Park from 4 to 6 June 2027.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: The Menzingers confirmed for 2000trees 2027

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Zebrahead mark 30 years with German tour

Zebrahead are celebrating 30 years with the 30 Years of Wrecking Europe Tour. After an opening show in Vienna on 27 November 2026, the band plays eleven German cities from 1 to 12 December, from Nuremberg to Hamburg. Punk Rock Factory are confirmed as support.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Still Talk and Catapults announce German tour

Still Talk, a pop-punk and emo band from Cologne, and Catapults share the top of the bill on a German club tour in early 2027. Eight shows run from 27 January in Nuremberg to 6 February in Bremen. Still Talk formed in 2022 and are named after a Jimmy Eat World song.
